name: Sanctuary
primary:
A sanctuary that heals, protects and revives the fallen.
A zone at the aim point with a 5-block radius for 12 s. Every second, on everyone inside, including you (damage and control only hit enemies):
• Heals 3 ❤
• Regeneration: +1.5 ❤ every 2 s for 10 s
• Growth: up to 6 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
• Revives the nearest fallen player or creature within 5 blocks with 30% health
• Puts out fire
• Stone skin (Resistance II) for 3 s
